subject: AWS Marketplace listing — technical claims + customer journey copy review
messages:
From: Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@acmecloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing next steps + hero/technical guidance

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Acme Cloud is excited to move forward with a co-sell listing for Redwood on AWS Marketplace. AWS asked that we share the initial product-page copy and technical claim language this week so internal review can start.

Can your team:
- Share a short hero blurb (1–2 sentences) that clearly states the core customer outcome?
- Provide 3–4 prioritized technical claims we can validate against AWS marketing guidelines (performance, isolation, throughput, integration points).
- Confirm SKU/pricing model (metered v. subscription) and attach any SKU matrix you want AWS to reference.

We have AWS MPM looped on this thread (cc’d). Ethan at Partner Creative will help with formatting for the product page.

Timeline: AWS asked for draft copy by EOD Thursday (9/24) to avoid schedule slip. Let me know if that’s doable.

Thanks —
Sofia Patel
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Acme Cloud
sofia.patel@acmecloud.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing next steps + hero/technical guidance

Hi Sofia —

Thanks — timeline is tight but doable if we focus scope. Attaching the AWS requirements doc and a SKU/pricing matrix for our recommended models. Vanessa will draft the hero + technical claims and include a short customer journey (discovery -> trial -> onboarding -> scale) that maps to the product page sections.

Action plan:
1) Vanessa: produce hero blurb + 3–4 technical claims + 2 example bullets for customer outcomes (draft attached).
2) Laura: confirm legal/marketing guardrails for claims and any badging musts for AWS co-sell.
3) Karthik: consolidate and send to AWS + Acme by EOD Thu (9/24).

Attachments: marketplace_requirements_0922.pdf, sku_pricing_matrix.xlsx

If AWS needs different phrasing for security/compliance callouts (SOC2, data residency), flag that now and we'll include it in the hero or in the technical details section.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan@partner-creative.com>, AWS Marketplace Program <aws-mpm@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Product page hero + technical claims (v0.1)

Hi all —

Attached is v0.1 of the product page copy (redwood_aws_product_page_draft.docx). Below are the specific items requested. Please review and call out edits inline or reply with short bullets — we need a tight pass by Thursday.

Hero blurb (candidate A):
Redwood Inference accelerates production LLM features with predictable low latency and cost-efficient serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.

Technical claims (prioritized):
1) Production-grade latency and throughput — continuous batching and kernel selection for sub-50ms p99 on common seq lengths (internal benchmark).
2) Cost controls for cloud-scale workloads — intelligent batching, KV caching, and quantization profiles that reduce per-token cost by up to 3x vs naive serving.
3) Deployment flexibility — same API and operational tooling across hosted, dedicated, and VPC/private installs for regulated customers.
4) Security and compliance — optional customer-managed key integration and audit logs; SOC 2 controls documented.

Customer journey bullets (for page sections):
- Discover: Try hosted demo and quickstart with sample prompts.
- Evaluate: Use built-in evals and cost profiler to baseline performance.
- Deploy: Choose hosted, dedicated, or private; pin model versions; configure rollout.
- Operate: Per-route dashboards, tracing, and automated fallbacks to preserve SLAs during load spikes.

Open items for AWS/Acme: please confirm if AWS wants explicit numeric claims in the hero (e.g., “sub-50ms p99”) or if those need to live in a technical footnote. Also confirm approved compliance badges.

Vanessa Ortiz
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: AWS Marketplace Program <aws-mpm@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 14:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Product page hero + technical claims (v0.1)

Thanks for the draft — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifying Qs before legal review:

1) Pricing/SKU model: we need a final answer on whether Redwood will publish a metered SKU (per-inference token or compute unit) or a subscription SKU. Metered SKUs require usage reporting integration.
2) Numeric performance claims: AWS prefers keeping hero language outcome-focused and moving numeric p99/p50 numbers to a Technical Specifications section. If you include numbers in marketing copy we’ll ask for source benchmarks and test conditions.

Please reply with the SKU decision and an ETA for the bench notes (if you intend to publish p99). If you prefer, we can accept a hero without numbers and have a linked Technical Specs doc.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Team
aws-mpm@amazon.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Program <aws-mpm@amazon.com>, Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan@partner-creative.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Product page hero + technical claims (v0.1)

Hi everyone —

Thanks for the guidance, AWS. Consensus from our side:
- SKU/pricing: publish a subscription SKU for the co-sell listing (monthly tiers) + an optional metered add-on SKU for burst/computation-heavy workloads. Attached is sku_pricing_matrix.xlsx with proposed tier names and baseline units.
- Numeric claims: we will remove numeric p99 from the hero and move any benchmark numbers to a linked Technical Specs PDF. We’ll deliver bench notes for AWS review by next Wed (9/30).

Next steps:
- Vanessa to finalize hero without numeric claims (v0.2) and update the Technical Specs link placeholder in the draft product page.
- Laura to run final compliance checklist and confirm SOC2 phrasing.
- Karthik will consolidate and send final copy + attachments to AWS + Acme by EOD Wed (9/30) to keep the marketplace timeline.

Links: https://drive.google.com/redwood/aws-product-page-draft (live draft)
HubSpot: HS-Contact-48291

If anyone needs an async review session, I’m available tomorrow 10–11 PT.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
